scope: resource amount calibration and global bundle budget freeze

unchanged_core_research.learning_route: first-order state x eligible-candidate marginal utility; other optional components OFF

unchanged_core_research.cross_fitting: exact mechanical target/evidence lineage primary; semantic/shared-session grouping sensitivity only

scoped_override.old_rs_clause: Top-1 single injection is the final primary treatment
scoped_override.new_rs_clause: Top-1 is retained as an original candidate design point, not the final primary. A global outcome-calibrated resource amount and token budget is frozen before formal effects.
retained_rs_contracts: one accepted atomic-move unit remains the irreducible catalog unit
BGE-M3 remains the formal retriever embedding
Step1 decides inject-or-not for the frozen retrieved bundle
Step2 executes the assigned bundle and may not filter, rerank, or estimate utility

candidate evaluator set and human reference are frozen
evaluator qualification protocol, metrics, thresholds, blindness and cost ledger are frozen
calibration item identities and API/GPU hard caps are researcher-approved

may_open_only_after: k and typed bundle are frozen
Generator and Step2 full-stack identity are frozen
matched-random, seeds and call plan are frozen

CONFIRMATORY_OUTCOME_LOCK.scope_if_opened: confirmatory ESC-Eval and ES-MemEval official outcomes only

rs_amount_calibration.source: 15061 materialized atomic-move retrieval documents with real BGE-M3 ranking
rs_amount_calibration.expansion_rule: Expand once to k={6,8} only if k=4 has the highest calibration mean and k=3 lies outside the one-standard-error admissible set relative to k=4; materialize canonical top-8 and re-audit one shared nonbinding cap before expanded calls.
rs_amount_calibration.exact_alias_rule: canonicalize exact rendered_card_text SHA-256; retain union of atomic unit, source card, dialogue and family provenance
rs_amount_calibration.formal_prerequisite: materialize one-score-per-exact-treatment canonical-catalog BGE ranking with deterministic backfill beyond the current audited top-4 prefix before any Generator calibration call

memory_amount_calibration.sparsity_rule: MP/ME are not assumed to support an ordinary wide Top-k sweep; report realized full-k coverage and never use synthetic rescue

task_surfaces.QA: static visible question plus typed BGE-ranked bundle/token surface
task_surfaces.Summary: static visible summary request plus typed BGE-ranked bundle/token surface
task_surfaces.DialogueGeneration: only unranked capacity/token envelopes until the official 10-round dynamic query is audited and mechanically frozen

memory_amount_calibration.dg_dynamic_query_gate: IMPLEMENTATION BLOCKER — RESEARCHER DECISION REQUIRED before calibration outcome

esc_evaluator_qualification.forbidden: selecting the evaluator that makes Ours score highest
esc_evaluator_qualification.primary_candidate: official ESC-RANK at pinned InternLM2-chat-7B plus seven English adapters
esc_evaluator_qualification.runtime_gate: qualify the official fp16 stack on a rented >=24 GiB GPU; local RTX 2070 cannot hold the 15.49 GB base weights
esc_evaluator_qualification.alternative_candidate_rule: only nominate an alternative if the cloud ESC-RANK runtime proves operationally impractical; Qwen remains proxy-only
esc_evaluator_qualification.human_label_interpretation: missing public item-level human validation labels does not block official ESC-RANK evaluation; it limits agreement qualification for alternatives

rq2_outer_cross_fitting.selection_isolation: For each held-out outer fold, amount selection may read only its outer-training calibration outcomes. The globally frozen object is the candidate grid, budget rule and selection algorithm; any fold-specific k*_f is produced without that fold's target outcomes.

formal_resource_amount_selection.rule: quality-first one-standard-error, then minimum mean Generator input-token cost
formal_resource_amount_selection.one_se_definition: Let g_best maximize the prespecified official primary anchor. The admissible set has mean(g) >= mean(g_best) - SE(g_best), using the prespecified clustered uncertainty unit. Choose the admissible grid point with minimum mean Generator input tokens; ties use smaller k, then canonical grid order.

memory_task_specific_anchors.QA: official LLM-as-Judge semantic correctness primary; F1/BERTScore auxiliary or tie evidence
memory_task_specific_anchors.Summary: official Event F1 primary with official LLM Score as semantic/faithfulness guard; ROUGE explanatory
memory_task_specific_anchors.DialogueGeneration: official Weighted Score primary with LT-Memory, Personalization and Emotional Support as guards/explanatory metrics

bge_gate.pooling_config_fix: supports and cross-checks SentenceTransformers direct-string and boolean pooling schemas; malformed, ambiguous or disagreeing schemas fail closed
bge_gate.identity_interpretation: Runtime identities differ and caches are deliberately non-interchangeable; the new surfaces bind the existing census identity and do not mix or re-encode vectors.
